caller.order: Copies old service state, constructs and assigns fresh defaults from 0x140d47ae0, calls service+8 virtual slot +0x18 to populate an 8-byte value at stack+0x38, then calls 0x140d56db0(state=service+0x10, section=service+0x1d8, value=&stack+0x38). Subsequent virtual configuration passes occur after discovery.
caller.default_fields: Constructor 0x140d47ae0 initializes state+0 byte to 1, state+8 environment string empty, state+0x38 Protocol to http, state+0x48 Domain to <unconfigured>, state+0x58 BasePath and state+0x68 ServiceName empty, and state+0x78 EngineName to UE4. The strings are copied from runtime literals 0x145b23e50, 0x145b0da80 and 0x145b23e60 respectively.

discovery.delegate_accessor: 0x140d4cdc0 returns the shared discovery delegate at 0x1480dfb10. Its layout and call pattern match FDelegateBase: allocation pointer at +0 and DelegateSize in allocation units at +8, not a provider count. The hook checks size, allocation and instance virtual +0x28 (IsSafeToExecute), returning if any check fails.
discovery.enabled_path: Calls 0x140d58600(state) first. It makes an owned copy of the FString at state+8 (length at state+0x10), then invokes the delegate instance virtual +0x48 (Execute) with section, pointer to copied environment FString, pointer to caller-provided 8-byte value, and state. It frees the temporary string after the call. The callback may modify state; the wrapper itself directly changes only state+8 through the selector. Exact callback writes are not established.
discovery.delegate_stability: The delegate is fetched again before Execute; the code assumes an instance remains present after IsBound. The captured allocation points outside the mapped image, so the bound instance and callback are not identified. See ../mcp_discovery_delegate_runtime/evidence.json.

environment_selection.fallback: Otherwise parses command line EPICAPP= into state+8; if FString length is <=1, tries EPICENV=; if still <=1, tries MCPCONFIG=. The fallback is entered only inside the bound discovery-delegate path when invoked through this hook. Selector does not run at all when the discovery delegate is unbound or unsafe.
environment_selection.distinct_delegate: Uses a separate delegate returned by 0x140d4cd50, not the discovery delegate returned by 0x140d4cdc0. If its DelegateSize, allocation and virtual IsSafeToExecute checks succeed, it invokes virtual Execute and moves the returned FString into state+8, then returns, even if the string is empty.

implementation_boundary: Implement the observed unbound discovery-delegate path by leaving fresh defaults for the following configuration passes; do not unconditionally select command-line environment at this hook. The bound path requires the actual registered callback and its behavior, including fields mutated and sources. Do not infer the live callback from the separate construction candidate, substitute an endpoint, or claim full discovery closure.
